exercises.question: Which tense gives the background in this sentence? [¿Qué tiempo da el contexto?] «Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se rompió.»
options: imperfecto [we were sleeping]
indefinido [broke]
futuro [will break]

exercises.sentence: Mientras __, una tubería se rompió. (dormir) [While we were sleeping, a pipe broke.]

exercises.english: There was a leak, so we called the landlord.

sentences: Una tubería se rompió. [A pipe broke.]
El agua empezó a salir. [The water started coming out.]
Tuvimos que llamar al propietario. [We had to call the landlord.]

exercises.question: Which connector introduces a consequence? [¿Qué conector introduce una consecuencia?]
options: por eso [therefore / that is why]
mientras [while]
aunque [although]

exercises.sentence: El agua __ parte de la cocina, por eso tuvimos que salir. (inundar) [The water flooded part of the kitchen, so we had to leave.]

exercises.english: When the technician arrived, we had already turned off the water.

exercises.sentence: Había una fuga, así que llamamos al propietario inmediatamente.
options: There was a leak, so we called the landlord immediately.
There was a repair, so the landlord called us.
There is a leak, so we will leave tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: El agua inundó parte de la cocina, por eso tuvimos que salir.
options: The water flooded part of the kitchen, so we had to leave.
The kitchen flooded because we had already left.
The water will flood the kitchen, so we are leaving tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Cuando llegó el técnico, ya habíamos cerrado la llave del agua.
Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se rompió y el agua empezó a salir.
options: While we were sleeping, a pipe broke and the water started coming out.
While we were sleeping, the pipe was repaired and the water stopped.
We slept after the pipe broke and the water had already gone.
Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se rompió y la cocina se inundó. [While we were sleeping, a pipe broke and the kitchen flooded.]
Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se romperá y la cocina se inundaba mañana. [While we were sleeping, a pipe will break and the kitchen was flooding tomorrow.]
Mientras dormimos, una tubería había romper y la cocina se inundará ayer. [While we sleep, a pipe had break and the kitchen will flood yesterday.]
El agua inundó parte de la cocina, así que tuvimos que salir. [The water flooded part of the kitchen, so we had to leave.]
El agua inundaba parte de la cocina, así que saldremos ayer. [The water was flooding part of the kitchen, so we will leave yesterday.]
El agua ha inundado parte de la cocina, así que salíamos mañana. [The water has flooded part of the kitchen, so we were leaving tomorrow.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué habíais hecho antes de que llegara el técnico?

options: Ya habíamos cerrado la llave del agua porque había una fuga. [We had already turned off the water because there was a leak.]
Ya cerrábamos la llave del agua porque habrá una fuga mañana. [We were turning off the water because there will be a leak tomorrow.]
Ya cerramos la llave del agua porque había una fuga mañana. [We turned off the water because there was a leak tomorrow.]

template.prompt: Describe a problem at home using the imperfecto and indefinido.
template.answer: Mientras dormíamos, una tubería se rompió y el agua inundó la cocina., así que tuvimos que buscar una solución.

template.prompt: Explain the consequence of a household problem.
template.answer: Había una fuga, así que llamamos al propietario inmediatamente.
